text:
Priya Shah: quick follow-up from today's all-hands: we need clarified timelines for: 1) streaming API beta/GA, 2) Console rollout controls (canaries/weights/fallback), and 3) Optimize suggestions (batching/quantization). can leadership confirm windows and any blockers?

Leila Morgan: short answers first: streaming beta = target mid-Aug 2026; GA = early Nov 2026. Console rollout controls beta = Oct 2026; GA = Jan 2027. Optimize suggestions initial beta = Dec 2026, GA TBD depending on evals. these are targets.

Daniel Kim: engineering caveat: to keep August streaming beta we need all streaming client APIs merged by July 10 and kernel perf fixes by June 20. there's a tokenization edge-case regression in latest internal build that risks latency spikes.

Priya Shah: does that tokenization regression affect Console rollout too?

Daniel Kim: Console feature set depends less on tokenizer but depends on runtime stability. if we push kernel fixes quickly Console beta can stay on schedule; otherwise expect 3-4 week slip.

Omar Ali: infra note: Dedicated customers need extra capacity validation. plan is Dedicated beta ~6 weeks after hosted beta, private deployments by request after GA. network and telemetry plumbing for rollout toggles is almost ready.

Nina Brooks: ops/policy clarifications: Console rollout will ship with presets (5%, 25%, 50%, 100%) and recommended rollback triggers (5% error-rate or 30% p99 latency increase). Optimize will start as "recommendations only" (UI + CLI) — no automatic changes initially.

Priya Shah: any details on what Optimize recommendations surface first?

Leila Morgan: first wave: batching window (ms), KV cache TTL, and quantization profile suggestions (int8 / int8+afternorm), plus cost/quality tradeoff estimates per suggestion. we'll include a small eval harness for teams to run locally.

Daniel Kim: SDKs: streaming helpers for python/js will be in the beta SDKs. sample JS snippet for streaming that we'll add to docs:

```js
const res = await client.stream.create({ model: 'redwood-7b', stream: true })
res.on('token', t => process.stdout.write(t))
res.on('done', () => console.log('stream done'))
```

Priya Shah: thanks. can product attach the sample eval harness and a short checklist to the roadmap ticket by 2026-06-15? engineering to confirm kernel freeze and regression status by 2026-06-01. docs/commms draft by 2026-07-01.

Nina Brooks: noted. also we'll provide rollout policy presets as UI shortcuts + a JSON export for infra automation.

Omar Ali: deploy-bot: scheduled canary infra test for streaming will run 2026-06-05 02:00 UTC. expect 10m of degraded throughput while we validate.

deploy-bot: [automated] canary test scheduled for 2026-06-05 02:00 UTC.

Priya Shah: action items recap:
- Product (Leila): attach eval harness + prompts to roadmap ticket by 2026-06-15
- Eng (Daniel): confirm kernel freeze date and regression status by 2026-06-01
- Infra (Omar): confirm Dedicated validation plan and canary window schedule by 2026-06-07
- Docs (Nina): draft beta launch comms by 2026-07-01

Leila Morgan: I'll open the follow-up doc and ping owners. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
